name: Legacy of the Aspects
summary: In the Horde trial, seekers must find Legacy of the Aspects and remember its lessons. The ancient tome lies in Dor'Danil Barrow Den in southern Ashenvale, where it holds lore about the Great Aspects who shaped ancient Azeroth.

sections.title: A Test of the Mind
sections.body:
Braug Dimspirit sends aspirants to seek Legacy of the Aspects. Earlier trials set by tauren elders test endurance and resolve. This trial tests the mind. Braug waits at the entrance to the Talondeep Path in the Stonetalon Mountains, while the tome lies in the haunted barrow dens of Dor'Danil.

Restless spirits of fallen druids and the vicious creatures that slew them guard the ancient text. It rests on a stone pedestal. Finding the volume is only the beginning. Before returning it, the seeker must commit its contents to memory. Then Braug tests them on its lessons in history.

faq.answer: Legacy of the Aspects rests on a stone pedestal in the lower chambers of Dor'Danil Barrow Den in southern Ashenvale, south of Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Why does Braug Dimspirit want this book?
faq.answer: Braug Dimspirit uses the tome for the Test of Lore. The trial tests whether an adventurer can study and recall vital historical knowledge, as well as wield physical strength.

faq.q: What happens if you fail to study the text before speaking to Braug?
faq.answer: Braug questions seekers on the book's lore as soon as they collect it. A wrong answer brings swift magical banishment, sending the unprepared petitioner far away to Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer, you face a traditional rite of passage. It tests whether your wisdom and knowledge match your physical might.
As a druid, you find the text deep in Dor'Danil Barrow Den, among the tragic, tormented spirits of fallen night elf druids.
